tool.name: Pling align
tool.description: cluster plasmid sequences using alignment-based integerisation
tool.command: mkdir -p inputs pling_out && python '$__tool_directory__/write_manifest.py' --output genomes_list.txt --input-dir inputs #for $genome in $genomes --genome '$genome' '$genome.element_identifier' #end for #if $topology.topology_source == "file" --topology-input '$topology.topology_file' --topology-output topology.tsv #end if && pling cluster align genomes_list.txt pling_out --cores "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --containment_distance '$containment_distance' --dcj '$dcj' --batch_size '$advanced.batch_size' --identity '$advanced.identity' --min_indel_size '$advanced.min_indel_size' --bh_connectivity '$advanced.bh_connectivity' --bh_neighbours_edge_density '$advanced.bh_neighbours_edge_density' --small_subcommunity_size_threshold '$advanced.small_subcommunity_size_threshold' --visualisation '$visualisation.scope' #if $visualisation.scope == "none" --output_type html #elif 'html' in $visualisation.output_type and 'json' in $visualisation.output_type --output_type both #elif 'json' in $visualisation.output_type --output_type json #else --output_type html #end if --ilp_solver GLPK $advanced.regions #if $advanced.sourmash_prefilter.enabled == "yes" --sourmash --sourmash_threshold '$advanced.sourmash_prefilter.sourmash_threshold' #end if #if $topology.topology_source == "file" --topology topology.tsv #end if && graph_dir="pling_out/dcj_thresh_${dcj}_graph" && cp "\${graph_dir}/objects/typing.tsv" '$typing' && cp "\${graph_dir}/objects/hub_plasmids.csv" '$hub_plasmids' && cp pling_out/all_plasmids_distances.tsv '$distances' #if $visualisation.scope != "none" and 'json' in $visualisation.output_type && mkdir -p json_visualisations && for json_file in "\${graph_dir}"/visualisations/*/jsons/community_*.json; do json_name=\$(basename "\${json_file}"); cp "\${json_file}" "json_visualisations/\${json_name}"; done #if $visualisation.scope == "all" && for json_file in pling_out/containment/containment_communities/visualisations/communities/jsons/community_*.json; do json_name=\$(basename "\${json_file}"); cp "\${json_file}" "json_visualisations/containment_\${json_name}"; done #end if #end if #if $visualisation.scope != "none" and 'html' in $visualisation.output_type && mkdir -p '$html_visualisations.extra_files_path' && cp -r "\${graph_dir}/visualisations/." '$html_visualisations.extra_files_path'/ #if $visualisation.scope == "all" && mv pling_out/containment/containment_communities/visualisations/communities '${html_visualisations.extra_files_path}/containment_communities' #end if && cp '$html_index' '$html_visualisations' #end if

param.name: genomes
param.label: Complete plasmid FASTA sequences
param.help: Select two or more complete plasmid FASTA or compressed FASTA datasets. Each selected dataset is written to the Pling manifest as one plasmid.

param.label: Containment distance threshold
param.help: Maximum containment distance between plasmids. Default: 0.5.

param.label: DCJ-Indel distance threshold
param.help: Maximum rearrangement distance used for clustering. Default: 4.

param.name: topology_source
param.label: Genome topology
param.help: Input sequences are assumed to be circular by default. Specify any sequences known to be linear. For Flye, check column 4 (Is circular, Y/N) in assembly_info.txt. For SPAdes, check GFA scaffold paths; TP:Z:circular marks circular paths. For Autocycler, use the reported topology or inspect the final GFA/FASTA. For NCBI-formatted FASTA, check the header for [topology=circular] or [topology=linear].

param.name: topology_file
param.label: Topology TSV
param.help: Tab-separated file with a header row and two columns: plasmid and topology. Include exactly one row for every selected dataset, including circular plasmids. Each plasmid value must match a selected dataset identifier exactly, including the file extension shown by Galaxy (for example, sample.fasta rather than sample). Topology must be circular or linear.

param.name: scope
param.label: Visualisation scope
param.option: All visualisations, including the initial containment network

param.label: Genome-pair batch size
param.help: Number of genome pairs processed together during alignment integerisation and DCJ calculation. Default: 200.

param.label: Minimum sequence identity for shared blocks (%)
param.help: Alignment identity threshold used while converting FASTA sequences into shared integerised blocks. Default: 80%.

param.label: Minimum indel block size (bp)
param.help: Minimum insertion/deletion block size considered during integerisation. Default: 200 bp.

param.name: regions
param.label: Treat input FASTA records as regions embedded in circular genomes
param.help: Use only when FASTA records represent regions within circular plasmids rather than complete plasmid sequences.

param.label: Small subcommunity size threshold
param.help: Communities containing at most this many plasmids are joined to neighbouring larger subcommunities. Default: 4.

param.label: Hub plasmid minimum connectivity
param.help: Minimum connectivity used when identifying hub plasmids. Default: 10.

param.label: Maximum edge density among hub-plasmid neighbours
param.help: Maximum edge density among hub plasmid neighbours. Default: 0.2.

param.label: Sourmash prefilter threshold
param.help: Containment-like threshold used to prefilter plasmid pairs before alignment. Default: 0.85.

tool.help:
Pling clusters complete plasmid sequences using sequence-content containment and DCJ-Indel rearrangement distance.
**Inputs**
Select two or more complete plasmid FASTA or compressed FASTA datasets. Draft assemblies, short contigs, and multi-plasmid FASTA files are not supported by this wrapper.
Before clustering, FASTA sequences are converted into integerised blocks using Pling's built-in alignment workflow.
By default, Pling treats every input plasmid as circular. If any inputs are known to be linear, provide a topology table with columns named ``plasmid`` and ``topology``. The table must contain exactly one row for every input, including circular plasmids. Additional columns are ignored. Plasmid names must match the selected dataset identifiers exactly, including any file extension shown by Galaxy, and topology values must be lowercase ``circular`` or ``linear``. Blank fields, unknown or duplicate labels, missing datasets, and other topology values are rejected.
Use ``Treat input FASTA records as regions`` only when the FASTA records are regions embedded in circular genomes rather than complete plasmid sequences.
**Key parameters**
``Containment distance threshold`` Maximum distance based on shared sequence content, calculated relative to the smaller plasmid.
``DCJ-Indel distance threshold`` Maximum rearrangement distance used when clustering plasmids after integerisation.
``Minimum sequence identity percentage for shared blocks`` Alignment identity threshold used while converting FASTA sequences into shared integerised blocks.
``Minimum indel block size`` Minimum insertion/deletion block size considered during integerisation.
**Main outputs**
* typing: plasmid-to-subcommunity assignments from ``typing.tsv``. * DCJ-Indel distances: pairwise distances from ``all_plasmids_distances.tsv``. * hub plasmids: hub plasmids from ``hub_plasmids.csv``. * HTML visualisations: a Galaxy HTML report linking to the final DCJ-threshold community and subcommunity graph pages. The initial containment-network community pages are also included when all visualisations are requested. * JSON visualisations: Cytoscape graph JSON files collected using unique names. Initial containment-network communities are prefixed with ``containment_``.
